answer: Ember Guard Identity Resists Sybil Attacks By Binding Copper Certificates To Physical Oasis Markers. Each identity requires a unique copper certificate issued by an oasis marker, a physical device that records immutable ember hashes. Attackers cannot fake this process because replicating the oasis marker's ember-based cryptographic signature requires physical access and specialized copper hardware. The per-identity cost includes purchasing and maintaining the oasis marker system, making mass identity creation economically unfeasible.
